pr_title: stm32U5 enable clock for the SDMMC peripheral
pr_body:
For some stm32 devices, including the stm32U5 serie, the SDMMC clock selection is HSI 48MHz by default (reset value).
This is the bit 14 position of the RCC CCIPR2 (peripheral independent clock configuration register 2)

To access the SDMMC peripheral correctly, the HSI48 must be on an ready.

The DTS of the stm32U5 is including the sdmmc1 & sdmmc2 nodes.

The ErrorCode of the HAL_SD_Init is also reported when is fails (0x0 is for NO error), so the reason for failing is given (see [stm32u5xx_ll_sdmmc.h](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/hal_stm32/blob/main/stm32cube/stm32u5xx/drivers/include/stm32u5xx_ll_sdmmc.h) for ErroCode definition).


Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/49154

Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu [francois.ramu@st.com](mailto:francois.ramu@st.com)
pr_comments:
> @FRASTM Admittedly less familiar with the hardware here, but changes look reasonable to me. How what this change verified? Is there an ST board with the SDHC pins broken out that could be used as a demonstration platform here?

The answer comes from the ErrorCode placed when the HAL_SD_Init fails (in the stm32u5xx_hal_sd.c)
When the SDMMC clock is wrong, the failure comes from the HAL_SD_InitCard  when _sdmmc_clk_ is null the ErrorCode = SDMMC_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER (0x08000000U).
When the SDMMC is clocked by HSI48 (HSI48 enabled), the correctly is _sdmmc_clk_ get  at 48000000 and a failure comes later (because NO card is mounted on the hw)  from SD_PowerON in HAL_SD_InitCard (the ErrorCode =  SDMMC_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE (0x10000000U)

> @FRASTM Admittedly less familiar with the hardware here, but changes look reasonable to me. How what this change verified? Is there an ST board with the SDHC pins broken out that could be used as a demonstration platform here?

The stm32l562e_dk board has a sdmmc connector and seems not so far from the stm32U5 for clocking the sdmmc peripheral with HSI48 and could be adapted.

issue_context.body:

STM32 SDMMC driver isn't compatible with the u575 (?), I have defined the dts/dtsi from the SoC and board with the given pins, register and IRQ but I'm not able to use it. 

**Describe why you are asking for this support?**
I have added and configured the sdmmc for the U575 but it isn't working as expected.

- Error is coming from the HAL_SD_Init
- SDMMC Clock: 10 MHz
- SDMMC and FatFS working with same configuration in bare metal
